title: DEWP Single Inclusion Proof Bundle
description: A portable, offline-verifiable two-hop Merkle inclusion proof for one Witness Event (dewp.audit.inclusion-proof).

version.description: DEWP specification version. Pinned: an unrecognised version must fail schema validation rather than be waved through as a plain string.

kind.description: MUST be dewp.audit.inclusion-proof. There are no vendor-prefixed aliases (DEWP §6.5).

id.description: Opaque event identifier (RECOMMENDED UUIDv7). Distinct from seq.

canonical.description: The full DEWP Core (or profile) canonical preimage as an object or array; absent for COMMITMENT_ONLY entries.

anchorRef.description: Publication receipt for the daily root. A self-identifying commitment reference, not a signed anchor.

anchored.description: Producer claim that a publication receipt exists — COMMITMENT only. NOT independence; see externallyAnchored.

externallyAnchored.description: Producer claim that a §5.3 external anchor quorum (distinct INDEPENDENT issuers — neither SELF nor WEBHOOK — >= the producer's configured requirement) exists. Display/triage only — verifiers evaluate the signed anchors under their own policy.

externallyAnchoredRequired.description: The quorum size the producer evaluated `externallyAnchored` against. Without it the boolean is unreadable: a 1-of-1 deployment and a 2-of-N deployment both publish `true`. A producer claim like the flag itself — it states what the producer required, not what a verifier confirmed.

anchors.description: Multiple independent anchors over the same dailyRoot, for quorum verification (§5.3).

numericSeq.description: Stringified 64-bit integer; MUST NOT be a UUID.

inclusionProof.description: Two-hop Merkle inclusion proof. The four bounds fields are REQUIRED: this tree self-pairs an unpaired trailing node, so an unbounded path check accepts a proof for a leaf that was never in the tree (DEWP §11.1).

leafIndex.description: Position of this event's leaf within its block. MUST satisfy 0 <= leafIndex < blockLeafCount.

blockLeafCount.description: Number of leaves in the block tree. Determines the required blockProof length: ceil(log2(n)), or 0 when n <= 1.

checkpointLeafIndex.description: Position of this block root within the daily tree. MUST satisfy 0 <= checkpointLeafIndex < checkpointLeafCount.

checkpointLeafCount.description: Number of leaves in the daily tree. Determines the required checkpointProof length.

anchored.description: Producer claim that a publication receipt (anchorRef) exists — COMMITMENT only, structurally true for every checkpointed proof. NOT an independence claim; see externallyAnchored.

externallyAnchored.description: Producer claim that a §5.3 external anchor quorum (distinct INDEPENDENT issuers — neither SELF nor WEBHOOK — >= the producer's configured requirement) exists for this root. Display/triage only — a verifier establishes independence from the signed anchors under its own policy, never from this flag.

externallyAnchoredRequired.description: The quorum size the producer evaluated `externallyAnchored` against. Without it the boolean is unreadable: a 1-of-1 deployment and a 2-of-N deployment both publish `true`. A producer claim like the flag itself — it states what the producer required, not what a verifier confirmed.
